h1. Resource Management (GM App) — Dokumentasi Rilis v1.0.26

{info:title=Informasi Rilis}
* *Produk:* Resource Management (UI: Backend Operation)
* *Versi:* 1.0.26
* *Tanggal dokumen:* 22 Juni 2026
* *Status:* Produksi internal — fitur lengkap
* *Repository:* [SevaIrawan/bo_resource_management|https://github.com/SevaIrawan/bo_resource_management]
* *Release:* [Resource Management v1.0.26|https://github.com/SevaIrawan/bo_resource_management/releases/tag/v1.0.26]
* *Platform:* Desktop Electron — Windows, macOS, Linux (installer + auto-update)
* *Database:* Supabase (PostgreSQL + Realtime)
{info}

----

h2. 1. Ringkasan

Aplikasi desktop untuk memantau dan mengoperasikan *banyak akun WhatsApp dan Telegram* per brand marketing. Semua data bisnis (akun, grup, master, ticket, session) disimpan di *Supabase*. Login platform (WA/TG) berjalan di *Electron main process* dengan session lokal per PC.

*Pengguna:* tim internal perusahaan (bukan produk publik).

*Highlight v1.0.26:*
* Supabase *036*: PK `groups_master` = `(brand, platform, group_id)` — fix duplicate key scrape
* Satu RPC atomik `rm_commit_account_scrape` (daily + master)
* Multi-akun scrape paralel: progress + Cancel scrape per baris
* Scrape idle watchdog (bukan wall-clock 3600s)

----

h2. 2. Stack Teknis

||Lapisan||Teknologi||
|Desktop shell|Electron 36|
|UI|React 19, TypeScript, Vite 6, Tailwind CSS v4|
|Routing|React Router 7|
|Database|Supabase JS (service role via IPC)|
|WhatsApp|whatsapp-web.js + Puppeteer/Chrome (main process)|
|Telegram|Python sidecar Telethon (rm-telegram-sidecar.exe)|
|Export|SheetJS (xlsx)|
|Auto-update|electron-updater → GitHub Releases|

----

h2. 3. Arsitektur (Ringkas)

{code}
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Electron Renderer (React)               │
│  Account · Ticket · Reporting · Ops      │
└──────────────────┬──────────────────────┘
                   │ IPC
┌──────────────────▼──────────────────────┐
│  Electron Main                           │
│  Login WA/TG · Scraper · Job Queue · Update│
└───────┬─────────────────────┬───────────┘
        │                     │
   wa-sessions/          Telegram sidecar
   (per akun, lokal)     (per session UUID)
        │                     │
        └──────────┬──────────┘
                   ▼
           Supabase + Realtime
{code}

*Prinsip data:* UI hanya *membaca* Supabase (Reporting, modal group link, ticket). Perubahan data grup/admin lewat *Scrape* atau *automation job* di device, lalu tulis DB.

h2. 4. Navigasi Aplikasi

||Menu||Route||Fungsi||
|Group Monitoring|/|Dashboard utama — akun, sync, scrape, ticket, reporting, operations|
|Settings|/settings|Auto-sync, bahasa, worker policy WA/TG, stock policy, cek update|

*Bookmark dalam Group Monitoring:*
* *Account* — grid akun per brand

----

h2. 5. Fitur — Tab Account

h3. 5.1 Grid Akun (9 kolom)

||Kolom||Keterangan||
|Account / Brand|Nama akun & brand marketing|
|Status|Valid / Invalid / Pending|
|Session|Valid → Sync / Run; Invalid → login; Clear (X) purge session|
|Groups|Y/X — grup di device vs standar brand|
|On device|Total grup di daily/device|
|In brand|Joined di master brand (joinedInMaster / groupsTotal)|
|Admin|Y/X admin di device vs standar|
|Scraper|Timestamp / RUN / progress bar|
|Action|Sync, Scrape (via Sync), edit akun, group links|

h3. 5.2 Sync & Scrape (via Sync)

* *Sync (↻):* probe session device → update hitungan grup/admin → prompt Scraper Now / Later
* *Scrape (via Sync):* scrape penuh device → tulis daily → rebuild master → refresh grid & reporting → refresh UI realtime
* *Later:* tutup modal tanpa scrape
* *Cancel scrape:* stop total + lepas Chrome

*Skala:* hingga ~3000 grup per akun (WA store cap + timeout terukur).

h3. 5.3 Login Platform

||Platform||Metode||Penyimpanan session||
|WhatsApp|QR / phone linking|Folder lokal wa-sessions/session-{UUID} per PC|
|Telegram|QR|Sidecar + session string di DB|

*Clear Session (X):* purge disk WA + invalidate DB → login ulang bersih.

h3. 5.4 Modal Group Links

* *Groups on account:* semua baris daily akun (No, nama, ID, member, admin, is admin, invite link)
* *Admin vs master:* baris master brand + status join/admin dari daily
* Export Excel: RM-[nama akun]-YYYYMMDD.xlsx

h3. 5.5 Manajemen Akun

* Tambah / edit akun (label, phone, location MY/KH)
* Hapus akun → CASCADE DB + rebuild master
* Multi-slot per brand (100+ akun WA/TG)

----

h2. 6. Fitur — Tab Ticket (Issue)

h3. 6.1 Kontrak 5 Tipe Issue (per akun)

||Tipe||Arti||
|missing_group|Grup ada di master, belum join di daily akun|
|daily_junk_group (Group mismatch)|Grup di daily, tidak ada di master|
|not_admin|Sudah join, belum admin|
|duplicate_group_id|group_id sama, nama beda|
|duplicate_group_name|group_id beda, nama sama|

{warning:title=Bukan Issue}
Login / logout session *tidak* masuk ticket. Tidak ada ticket agregat group_count_mismatch.
{warning}

h3. 6.2 Workflow

* Kartu issue per brand + akun + tipe
* Double-click → detail tabel (Group ID, invite link, note)
* Modal proses ticket (status task, tanggal, remark)
* Auto-close setelah scrape/sync jika gap sudah tertutup
* Export Excel per issue atau semua issue terfilter
* Realtime Supabase → reload kartu

----

h2. 7. Fitur — Tab Reporting (Read-Only)

*Slicer:* Platform, Brand, Acc Name (All = matrix), bookmark Full Group / Full Admin, filter stock status, search nama grup.

||Mode||Isi||
|Matrix (Acc=All)|Baris groups_master × kolom akun (join/admin Yes/No)|
|Full Group|Semua baris daily akun terbaru per group_id|
|Full Admin|Master brand + status admin/join dari daily|

* Realtime: reload otomatis setelah scrape / perubahan master atau daily
* Export Excel sesuai slicer aktif

----

h2. 8. Fitur — Tab Operations

h3. 8.1 Bookmark Overview (Stock)

* Kartu per brand: jumlah master, stock bucket (new / active / idle / dll. sesuai policy)
* Drill-down modal per bucket → tabel grup + export Excel
* Policy stock & SOP naming di Settings

h3. 8.2 Bookmark Job Queue (Desktop Only)

Antrian otomasi per PC — *terpisah* dari Sync/Scraper di tab Account.

||Task||Fungsi device||
|Join missing|Join grup via invite link dari master (acceptInvite / sidecar)|
|Create group|Buat grup batch di device + export invite link|
|Set admin|Promote target ke admin di grup terpilih|

* UI: Setup modal → enqueue → tabel antrian (status, progress, RUN/PAUSE/CANCEL/VIEW)
* VIEW modal: tabel per task type + tombol *Export*
* Guard: Sync/Scraper diblok saat job queue aktif; settle 60s antar akun
* Worker delay & limit: Settings → Worker (WA / TG)

----

h2. 9. Fitur — Settings

||Bagian||Isi||
|System|Status Supabase, versi app, cek / unduh update|
|Language|EN / ZH|
|Auto-sync|Interval sync terjadwal per akun valid|
|Worker WhatsApp|Delay create/join/set admin, invite export retry, group settings|
|Worker Telegram|Delay, admin rights, flood wait|
|Operations stock policy|Threshold bucket per brand, SOP penamaan grup|

h2. 10. Pipeline Data Scrape (Kontrak Produksi)

{code}
Device (WA Electron / TG sidecar)
  → runAccountScraper
  → writeScrapeDailyRows
  → RPC rm_commit_account_scrape (atomik)
      DELETE daily (account_id) + INSERT daily + rebuild master brand+platform
  → applyResult grid + realtime reporting
{code}

*WA scrape v1.0.26:*
* Fase 1: metadata grup paralel (concurrency 4)
* Fase 2: invite link serial per grup admin (getInviteCode)
* Puppeteer protocolTimeout 10 menit + retry ProtocolError

*TG scrape:* invite via username atau ExportChatInviteRequest (sidecar).

----

h2. 11. Multi-Akun (100+ WA & TG)

||Platform||Device key||Batasan||
|WhatsApp|UUID messaging_accounts → folder wa-sessions|Lock per session; max ~4 Chrome global|
|Telegram|UUID akun → sidecar SESSIONS|Sequential antar akun; QR login v3|

Issue/KPI hanya dari grup & admin — bukan status login session.

h2. 13. Distribusi & Rilis

h3. 13.1 Tim IT (build)

* Bump version package.json → push main → GitHub Actions build Win/Mac/Linux
* Output: .exe (Windows), .dmg/.zip (macOS), .AppImage (Linux)
* Config organisasi terbundel: org-default.env

h3. 13.2 Tim Operator (pakai)

# Install sekali dari installer terbaru
# Login dashboard (users)
# Tambah akun → login WA/TG di HP marketing
# Sync / Scrape (via Sync) / pantau selisih & reporting & reporting
# Restart app saat ada notifikasi update
